Market today: The S&P 500 is hitting record highs, suggesting a bullish mood, but rising Treasury yields due to oil prices and upcoming inflation data could be a headwind for tech. AI demand remains a strong driver for your chip names.

Your holdings: SOXL (-48.92%, SELL) and SPAL (-39.96%, NEW) are both leveraged and deeply in the red; margin amplifies these drops. SMH (-10.52%, TRIM) also needs attention.

Watch: Keep a close eye on inflation data and bond yields, as well as the impact of Intel's $20 billion stock offering on the chip sector.

Bottom line: Prioritize managing risk on your leveraged, underwater positions in this high-flying, yet uncertain, market.
plays: Your SOXL is down nearly 50%. Respect its stop at 200 or consider trimming to reduce leveraged exposure and margin risk.
SPAL, a new leveraged position, is down 40%. Watch its stop at 21.38 closely to prevent further deep losses.
SMH is on TRIM status. Consider reducing exposure if it approaches its stop at 540, especially with Intel's stock offering news.
